critical_code_review_comments: SihDemo.jsx fix is correct: two-tier scan (Indian bbox first, then rest) + probe /candidates and break on first hit is more robust than the previous hard bbox pre-filter. slice(0,200) is a reasonable safety cap given /cases returns limit=1000.

Minor perf/API-noise: probing up to 200 /cases/{id}/candidates endpoints sequentially on every /demo load is O(n) round-trips; consider a backend endpoint like /api/cases/first-with-candidates or a lightweight has_candidates flag on the case list to eliminate the sequential probe.

rca_of_the_issue: Prior iteration filtered candidate probing to Arabian Sea only (lon 66–78), excluding the Chennai case (~80°E) that had the only real 5-candidate correlation. Current fix widens the priority band to full Indian waters (lon 66–95, lat 5–24), scans up to 200 cases, and falls through to any case globally if the Indian tier yields none — so the first case with a non-empty /candidates response is chosen. Verified end-to-end.
